doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Archie Bunker visits Basie's dressing room
summary: A funny story of a TV star coming to see Basie about his son's arrest and leaving an envelope of cocaine, which Basie dumped. The recording breaks.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I see Archie Bunker on the T.V, “WW II!” He’s talking and shit. His son had just been busted for this thing. (Imitates Bunker) “They had the nerve, Basie, to bust my son! These assholes!” So on, and so on. Then he put this envelope down on the bag. (Laughs) And the funniest thing happened I’ve ever seen in my life. The Count went in on him. He dumped it, and it looked like a little Mount Fuji. Basie didn’t even touch it. He says, (Fuller imitates Basie laughing). The shit left the table.
Turn this off. Turn it off. Turn it off! Turn it off!
(Laughing) I’m sorry, but that was so funny.
